info.description: The ComplianceWatch public API, v1 (guide section 10): the operations the services tag public, merged into one spec by `make openapi-public`. Each operation names the service that serves it in x-service and the tenant roles that may call it in x-roles. Errors are problem details (RFC 9457). A POST that creates something takes an Idempotency-Key header, and a list answers one page at a time with limit and cursor. CHANGELOG.md next to this file lists the changes per version.
info.title: ComplianceWatch public API
